The closing panel of the #FediDay2026 science track is online too (44 min):
Improving Researchability of the Fediverse

With @cypherhippie@chaos.social, @julian@fietkau.social, @marco_waehner@social.tchncs.de and me, moderated by Christina Dinar. We talked about consent, data trustees, trust in research, and why infrastructure only becomes visible when it fails.

https://fair.tube/w/ug1VCR3HR98HVNx7KGZ8JG
